Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText: DECLARE fh TEXT_IO.FILE_TYPE; l VARCHAR2(200); BEGIN fh := TEXT_IO.FOPEN('c:\temp\in.txt', 'r'); TEXT_IO.GET_LINE(fh, l); :F.LINE1 := l; TEXT_IO.GET_LINE(fh, l); :F.LINE2 := l; TEXT_IO.FCLOSE(fh); END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText: DECLARE fh TEXT_IO.FILE_TYPE; BEGIN fh := TEXT_IO.FOPEN('out/result.txt', 'w'); TEXT_IO.PUT_LINE(fh, 'written by ' || :F.LINE1); TEXT_IO.FCLOSE(fh); END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText: DECLARE fh TEXT_IO.FILE_TYPE; BEGIN fh := TEXT_IO.FOPEN('keep.txt', 'w'); END;
